sources.title: LeonaQuantum/leona-qompact-1.0 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: leona-qompact-1.0 An experimental LoRA adapter for natural-language-to-OpenQASM 3 generation. This is the final step (1,000 of 1,000) of the clean-v12 run. Training is complete, but the model is not yet quality-validated. No improvement over the base model is claimed; validation and final testing are incomplete.
